plain: The string that names the Identity Registry an agent lives in: chain family, chain id and registry address joined by colons, such as eip155:1 plus the address. Together with agentId it identifies an agent globally.
ste: A text value with the chain family, the chain number and the address of the registry.

plain: The ERC-721 contract that mints agent identities, stores agentURI and metadata, and holds the agentWallet. Not the same thing as the ERC-3643 Identity Registry.
ste: The contract that makes a token for each agent and keeps the address of its file.

plain: The third ERC-8004 registry, where a named validator records a 0 to 100 check of an agent's work. Specified in the Draft text, not officially deployed.
ste: A registry where a validator writes the result of a check. It is not officially on a chain.

plain: An optional object in an ERC-8004 feedback file with fromAddress, toAddress, chainId and txHash. It points to a payment such as an x402 settlement; the registry never stores or checks it.
ste: An object in the feedback file that identifies a payment transaction.

plain: A removed ERC-8004 mechanism: an agent-signed permission that a client needed before giving feedback. Removed from the contracts on 2025-11-12 and from the text on 2026-01-07.
ste: A permission that the agent signed for feedback. The standard does not use it now.

plain: An optional list in the registration file naming the trust models an agent supports, such as reputation, crypto-economic or tee-attestation. Empty means discovery only.
ste: A list of trust models that an agent supports.

plain: A counter that starts at 1 for the feedback one client gave one agent. Used to read, revoke or respond to a specific entry.
ste: A number that identifies one feedback item from one client.

plain: The number of decimal places (0 to 18) that applies to an ERC-8004 feedback value. An uptime of 99.77% is value 9977 with valueDecimals 2.
ste: The number of decimal places of a feedback value.

plain: An optional file an agent serves on a service domain to show it controls that domain, with a registrations entry that matches its on-chain id.
ste: A file on a web domain that shows that the agent controls the domain.

plain: The list of client addresses a reader passes to getSummary. ERC-8004 requires it because unfiltered feedback is open to Sybil attacks.
ste: The list of reviewers that a reader trusts.

plain: The identity contract used by ERC-3643 tokens. It holds keys by purpose and claims signed by trusted issuers, such as KYC results.
ste: A contract that keeps keys and signed claims for one identity.

plain: A Final ERC for permissioned tokens. Transfers pass only between wallets whose identities carry the claims the token requires.
ste: A standard for tokens that only verified holders can receive.

plain: A Draft ERC that lets a verified principal give an agent scoped, time-bounded and capped authority, using ERC-8004 for agent identity and ERC-3643 or ERC-7943 for token compliance.
ste: A draft standard that gives an agent limited authority for regulated tokens.
